description: Somos Amautas Mineros, un equipo de voluntarios de Cajamarca que mira la minería desde el cielo. Con los datos abiertos de la NASA queremos cuidar nuestro territorio y proponer ideas que sumen valor a nuestra región. Aquí cada idea cuenta, cada talento suma y juntos cavamos más profundo para encontrar soluciones brillantes como el oro. ¡Súmate y hagamos historia!
summary:
Space Masters is an interactive educational game that allows participants to take on the role of space engineers and design their own space missions, from initial planning to the simulation of their results. Through strategic decisions, players must select mission objectives, configure spacecraft, choose scientific instruments and launch vehicles, and manage limited resources such as budget, energy, and mass, while considering communication systems and orbital constraints.

The project addresses the challenge by transforming complex space engineering concepts into a practical, dynamic, and engaging experience. Its importance lies in promoting experiential learning, developing critical thinking, and strengthening problem-solving and decision-making skills. It allows participants to understand how every engineering choice can influence the success or failure of a space mission.
details:
Space Masters is an interactive educational game designed to introduce young people to the fascinating world of space exploration and NASA missions in a fun, dynamic, and accessible way. Through a digital platform, participants can become space engineers, design their own missions, establish objectives, configure spacecraft, select scientific instruments, and manage limited resources such as budget, energy, and mass. Furthermore, the game simulates the consequences of each decision, helping players understand how real space missions are planned and developed.

To develop this project, we used Base44, an application development platform that allowed us to build the game's interface and interactive features, making it accessible through computers, tablets, and smartphones with an internet connection.

Its main benefit is transforming complex scientific and technological concepts into an enjoyable learning experience, sparking young people's curiosity about the universe while developing skills such as creativity, critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making. Moreover, its creativity lies in combining education and entertainment, allowing participants to learn through experimentation while taking on the role of real space engineers.

During its development, our team particularly considered young people's age and interests, ease of use, visual appeal, understanding of scientific concepts, and the main constraints of a real space mission. Ultimately, we hope Space Masters will have a positive impact on education, encourage more young people to explore science, technology, engineering, and astronomy, and demonstrate that learning about NASA and space can be an exciting and enjoyable experience.
